props.label: Where our artists have played
props._notes: The client strip, the same block the other act pages carry.

props.html: He trained in Indian classical music on the tabla, a pair of hand drums, and he brings them with him. Played over the records, they give the crowd a musician to watch as well as a DJ, and the same set works without them when you book the DJ on his own.

In Denver he's played Your Mom's House six times, Larimer Lounge three times, Black Box and Beacon. Away from Colorado he's played Chicago, San Francisco, San Diego and Hong Kong, on bills with Night Tales, Win and Woo and Born Dirty.

He can play the warm-up while a crowd is still arriving and talking, the peak of the night once the floor is full, or one long set that covers both. He's based in Denver and takes dates across Colorado.

Both sets are on The Lamma Sounds, a Hong Kong promoter's channel, so they sit here and not in the hero. The headphones photograph is the hero and the roster card, so it is not repeated in the grid. Left out of the zip, each a curation call: six portraits that came only as narrow strips cut for the EPK layout (645 pixels wide), four video stills at 480 to 1080 pixels, twenty event flyers (posters, not photographs of him), three logo files, and the cover art for his Truth or Dare remix and his novel. No tabla footage exists yet; he said 2026-11-02 that a short clip is coming if he has one.

props.html: Stage sizes and power are on the technical page, and the questions every booking shares are on the full question list.

items.a: Afro house, deep house and amapiano, with global electronic records worked into the set. He's a Denver DJ booked through Signet Artists, and he can play live tabla over the set.

items.q: What does the live tabla need?
items.a: One microphone, one channel on the DJ mixer and a low stool. He brings the drums, and they take about ten minutes to set up.

items.q: What does he need from the venue?
items.a: Professional DJ decks, a mixer and a sound system. He plays on the venue's own where it has them, and where it doesn't, the gear is rented for the date and priced with it.
Anywhere from one hour to four, with the breaks planned around your program.
Yes. He takes dates across Colorado, and travel outside the Denver metro is priced with the date.
